Discoverer: Qihoo 360 Vulcan Team's Xiao Wei and Tianwen Tang
Method of Attack: Exploitation of use-after-free vulnerability in XHCI USB controller allowing code execution and privilege escalation, chained with privilege escalation via system call management bug
Attack Vector: Local administrative privileges on a virtual machine to exploit use-after-free bug in XHCI USB controller, followed by privilege escalation via system call management bug
